visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a black jacket with a white fur collar walks along a paved path, pushing a gray stroller with a small child inside. The background is filled with vibrant red and orange maple trees lining a white wooden fence. The lighting is bright natural daylight, creating high contrast between the leaves and the sky. (2) The scene transitions to an outdoor farm area under a clear blue sky. The woman, now wearing a pink and white varsity jacket and a white baseball cap, pushes the stroller across dry grass. Wooden barn structures and outdoor games are visible in the background. (3) Close-up shots of various farm animals behind wire fences are shown. The woman feeds a llama and a camel from a white paper cup. Several pigs, goats, and a large ostrich are shown in their respective enclosures while other visitors wander in the background. (4) A group of children are playing on a blue and yellow spinning seesaw structure. The woman in the pink varsity jacket is seen actively pushing and spinning the equipment, laughing and interacting with the kids. Red barns and hay bales form the background. (5) The woman interacts with a young child dressed in a black bear-themed hoodie. They observe animals and play with a vertical wooden game board. The video concludes with the woman walking away through the same red maple tree-lined path seen at the beginning.
